records.title: Military AI Cyber Agents (MAICAs) Constitute a Global Threat to Critical Infrastructure
records.reason: Primary abstract: This paper argues that autonomous AI cyber-weapons - Military-AI Cyber Agents (MAICAs) - create a credible pathway to catastrophic risk.

records.title: ABS: Enforcing Constraint Satisfaction On Generated Sequences Via Automata-Guided Beam Search
records.reason: Primary abstract: Sequence generation and prediction form a cornerstone of modern machine learning, with applications spanning natural language processing, program synthesis, and time-series forecasting.

records.title: TTrace: Lightweight Error Checking and Diagnosis for Distributed Training
records.reason: Primary abstract: Distributed training is essential for scaling the training of large neural network models, such as large language models (LLMs), across thousands of GPUs.

records.title: Learning to Weight Parameters for Training Data Attribution
records.reason: Primary abstract: We study gradient-based data attribution, aiming to identify which training examples most influence a given output.

records.title: Identity Testing for Circuits with Exponentiation Gates
records.reason: Primary abstract: Motivated by practical applications in the design of optimization compilers for neural networks, we initiated the study of identity testing problems for arithmetic circuits augmented with \emph{exponentiation gates} that compute the real function $x\mapsto e^x$.
